settings.title: Fine Knitwear & Cashmere
settings.content:
Liu Jo knitwear is created using premium natural fibers like wool, mohair, and cashmere. To preserve their ultra-soft feel:

  • Hand wash in cold or lukewarm water (max 30°C) with mild wool detergent.
  • Gently press out excess water between clean towels; do not wring.
  • Dry flat on a horizontal rack away from direct heat or sun.
  • Fold knitwear inside drawers; never hang to avoid stretching.

settings.title: Bottom Up Denim & Jeans
settings.content:
Our engineered Bottom Up denim maintains its sculpting elasticity and wash depth when properly treated:

  • Always turn jeans inside out before laundering.
  • Wash in cold water (max 30°C) on a delicate cycle.
  • Air dry hung by the hem; avoid tumble drying.
  • Iron on the reverse side with medium steam.

settings.title: Leather, Suede & Handbags
settings.content:
For Liu Jo jackets, footwear and handbags in genuine leather or eco-leather:

  • Clean smooth leather with a soft microfiber cloth dampened with neutral water.
  • Use a crepe brush for suede to revive the texture.
  • Store bags stuffed with tissue paper in their protective dust bags.

settings.title: Silk & Delicates
settings.content:
Silk blouses and dresses require delicate care:

  • Opt for specialist dry cleaning or delicate hand washing in cold water.
  • Never spray perfume or deodorant directly onto silk.
  • Iron while still slightly damp on the lowest silk setting.

settings.title: Down Outerwear & Puffer Coats
settings.content:
To retain the warmth and loft of down coats:

  • Close all zippers and snap buttons before washing.
  • Wash at 30°C on a down/delicate program with gentle spin.
  • Tumble dry on low heat with clean tennis balls to redistribute down plumage.

settings.panel_subheading: Protect the luxury quality, texture, and longevity of your Liu Jo garments with our specialist care guide.
